newsitem.title: USA: Intelligent Medical sees '96 results off.
newsitem.headline: Intelligent Medical sees '96 results off.

text.p: Intelligent Medical Imaging Inc said Tuesday after the market closed that it expects operating results to differ "materially" from analysts' expectations.

The company said it will not realize any product sales in the third quarter and possibly the fourth quarter, due to a failure of Coulter Corp to meet the minimum purchase requirements under their distribution ageement for Intelligent Medical's Micro21 Systems.
According to First Call, the mean analyst estimate for Intelligent Medical's 1996 earnings is $0.06 a share.
Intelligent Medical has an initial public offering of its stock in March, 1996.
